shots.name: X-Jet Orbit
shots.notes: Farthest-left shot (Blackbird orbit). Strong shots divert into the Danger Room; feeds Danger Room training and lights super jackpots. Shoot late off the right flipper to avoid the center-drain kickout.

shots.name: Downtown Ramp
shots.notes: Hybrid orbit/backwards-facing ramp hit late off the right flipper; feeds the same right flipper for the repeatable 5-Way Time Loop combo.

shots.name: Uptown Ramp
shots.notes: Left ramp. A To Me, My X-Men Cerebro lock shot; also the Berzerker MB super-jackpot start and the left-ramp Cerebro skill shot.

shots.name: Midtown Ramp
shots.notes: Center ramp. Primary mission-start shot (lit blue); the Save the City lock. Feeds back to the right flipper for repeats.

shots.name: Subway
shots.notes: Right-side ramp/loop, only hittable from the left flipper. Alternate mission-start/return shot. Nudge left to avoid the pop bumpers.

shots.name: Highway Ramp
shots.notes: Steep upper-right ramp, only reachable with strong left-flipper shots. A To Me, My X-Men Cerebro lock shot when lit.

shots.name: Sentinel Head
shots.notes: Center-back articulated robot head; bash to spawn/defeat for Sentinel Multiball. Lowering mouth acts as a scoop/kickback and doubles the super jackpot when open.

shots.name: Sentinel Magnet
shots.notes: Magnet in front of the Sentinel head; flings the ball when the Sentinel spawns.

shots.name: Sentinel Hands (Rising Body)
shots.notes: Prem/LE only: full Sentinel rises from beneath the playfield and attacks the ball / blocks ramps with extended hands; can start Sentinel Attack.

shots.name: Cerebro Post
shots.notes: Ball-lock post above the left flipper apex; holds virtual locks for To Me, My X-Men MB. Also the bonus-X build target area near the left flipper.

shots.name: Danger Room Mini-Flipper
shots.notes: Third flipper inside the secluded lower-left Danger Room mini-playfield.

shots.name: Danger Room Spinner
shots.notes: Novel outlane spinner on the left edge of the Danger Room; pays 1M/spin during the Save the City super.

shots.name: Danger Room Targets
shots.notes: Three standups; one below the mini-flipper holds bonus when lit. Advance Danger Room training.

shots.name: Danger Room Feed Ramp

shots.name: Danger Room Exit Ramp
shots.notes: Exit lane out of the Danger Room; the universal 2x/3x jackpot multiplier and super-jackpot reset shot, and a Cerebro lock shot.

shots.name: Nightcrawler Targets

shots.name: X-Mansion Target

goals.title: Hold-Both-Flippers Modes Menu
goals.summary: Away from the Danger Room and the Sentinel fight, the cabinet keeps a quieter menu tucked behind its attract loop. Holding both flipper buttons while the machine idles brings it up, and the choice made there governs the whole game before a single ball is plunged.
instructions: Wait until the machine is idle in attract mode with no game in progress
Hold both flipper buttons together until a menu appears on the display
The menu lists Standard, Competition, and DJ Mixer
Standard is the normal full ruleset
DJ Mixer is not a way to play at all — it works like a jukebox for the music in the machine, including a number of specific playlists
goals.reward: Standard, Competition, and a DJ Mixer jukebox

goals.title: Eight Missions, Eight Upgrades
goals.summary: Missions are not just points on this machine. You choose which one you play, and each one is fronted by a different X-Man and attached to a different upgrade to the rest of your game. The catch is the payout is back-loaded: clearing the mission only buys you a trip to the future, and you have to get back out of the future before the upgrade is actually yours.
instructions: Shoot the white shots until a blue shot strobes, then hit it. The center ramp is always one of the shots that starts a mission.
Pick your mission with the flippers and the action button. There are eight — four standard, four harder — and each one hands over its own upgrade.

The standard four buy control: Rescue the Innocent charges the action button off fewer bumper hits, Bitter Rivalry lengthens single-ball ball saves, Smuggled Cargo raises the Gambit bumper multiplier from 2x to 3x, and Stopping a Juggernaut lets the Danger Room count toward scoring in the future and gives you a ball save the first time you enter it each ball.

The harder four buy firepower: Sentinel Facility Raid qualifies an add-a-ball you take by holding the action button during a multiball, A Fiery Assault extends the next Sentinel Multiball you play, Mayhem in Midtown lengthens multiball ball saves, and Genosha Under Siege puts extra time on mission and future timers.
Clearing the mission sends you to the future, and nothing is banked yet. Finish what the future asks of you and take the escape at the center ramp — the upgrade only lands when you get out.
Shop deliberately. Choose the mission whose upgrade fixes what your game is short on, and choose one you can realistically close out, because a mission you cannot escape from pays nothing.
goals.reward: A different upgrade for every mission you complete and escape

goals.title: Train Enough to Bring Cyclops In
goals.summary: Danger Room training feels disposable, because your level gets wiped the moment you start a mission. It is not. The machine keeps a running count of the training levels you finish over the whole game, and once enough of them stack up Cyclops turns up for good and gives you more room to keep combos alive.
instructions: Feed the Danger Room with the X-Jet orbit. Balls also drop in there on their own, so be ready to play the mini-flipper whether you meant to go down or not.
Work the features inside it — the spinner, the targets, the ramp. Every shot you make advances the progress bar at the top of the display.
Fill the bar and you complete a training level. Starting a mission resets your level back to zero, but the level you finished still counts on the game's running total.
Keep going back down. Three completed training levels in one game brings Cyclops in, and every combo timer runs longer for the remainder of the game.
goals.reward: Longer combo timers for the rest of the game

drills.title: Cerebro Plunge
drills.text: Cycle the flippers at the plunge until the left-ramp Cerebro skill is lit, then full-plunge. It spots progress toward the team multiball and settles the ball safely on the left flipper, which is why it beats the higher-value options as a default.

drills.title: Danger Room Control
drills.text: Hit the X-Jet orbit hard enough to divert into the Danger Room, and hold the left flipper up as a reflex so the return does not slip past it. Down there, cradle on the mini-flipper before shooting, pick off the standups, and leave through the exit ramp to bank the level.

drills.title: Exit Ramp Follow-Up
drills.text: Take the X-Jet super, then combo straight into the Danger Room exit ramp before the window closes. That one ramp doubles the super and resets the jackpot ladder at a higher base, so it is the single shot worth drilling hardest on this machine.

drills.title: Sentinel Head Reps
drills.text: Bash the head until the mouth drops open, then put the ball in the open mouth. The open mouth doubles the super, so the drill is finishing on the mouth rather than settling for body hits once it is available.

drills.title: Time Loop Chain
drills.text: Hit Downtown late off the right flipper so it feeds back to the same flipper, and keep going up to five. After the fifth, take the lit left ramp for the sixth shot — it buys ball-save time, which makes this the one loop worth chasing when the ball is behaving.

drills.title: Fastball Pair
drills.text: With the combo lit at the right inlane, take the strobing left ramp, then combo the return into the Sentinel. The ramp returns to the left flipper, so the second half is a clean look — the mistake is pausing between them.

actionButton.label: Bishop (Action Button)
actionButton.how: The left pop bumper — sitting where a left sling would normally be — charges Bishop's power into the lockdown bar button. Flashing red means a use is banked, and you can hold three at once. Perks earned from missions change how fast it charges and what else it can do.

uses.when: Button flashing red during a mode
uses.what: Spots the most valuable lit shot, but never the Sentinel head or anything in the Danger Room.
Dead for the whole mode — every shot in it has to be made by hand.
Hold it while flashing green for an add-a-ball, once per ball.
Works with the flippers to choose which of the eight you start.
Fewer bumper hits recharge the button from then on, so presses come around faster.

howItPlays.objective: The Uncanny X-Men pits the team against the Sentinels and Magneto across eight X-Man-led missions. Train in the Danger Room to multiply your missions, topple the towering Sentinel head, and assemble the team through Cerebro on the way to Save Senator Kelly.
loop: Divert a hard X-Jet orbit shot into the secluded Danger Room and bank a training level so your next mission scores doubled.
Qualify a mission with white shots and start it at the blue center ramp, choosing which of the eight with the Bishop button and the flippers.
Clear the mission and escape the future to keep its permanent upgrade, since the payout is back-loaded.
Bash the Sentinel head for Sentinel Multiball, and after any super jackpot combo the Danger Room exit ramp to double it and reset the ladder higher.
Complete all eight missions to light Save Senator Kelly.

lights.name: Mission Shots
lights.lit: White shots qualify a mission, then the blue center ramp -- or the Subway from the left flipper -- starts the one you have selected; each of the eight wears a different X-Man's colors and carries its own upgrade to the rest of your game.

control.effect: the Bishop lockbar button and the flippers together let you pick which of the eight you start, so you shop for the upgrade you want rather than taking whatever is lit
control.when: when missions are lit and waiting

lights.then: The payout is back-loaded: clearing a mission only sends you into the future, and the upgrade stays out of reach until you fight your way back out of it. Complete all eight to light Save Senator Kelly.

lights.name: Danger Room Training
lights.lit: Hitting the X-Jet orbit hard enough diverts the ball into the secluded lower-left mini-playfield; cradle on its mini-flipper, pick off the three standups to climb the training bar, then take the exit ramp out to lock the level in.
lights.then: Level 1 doubles your next mission and Level 3 doubles the credit each Sentinel gives while padding out your mode timers; the level wipes when a mission starts, but the game keeps a running total, and enough finished levels brings Cyclops in for good with longer combo timers.

lights.name: Sentinel Head & Berzerker
lights.lit: Bashing the giant head spawns the Sentinel -- the magnet flings the ball as it appears -- and further hits open its mouth; only the open mouth starts the multiball, and it doubles the super jackpot too.
lights.then: Level the Danger Room first so Sentinel Multiball, the top scorer, launches with fat jackpots. Every Sentinel you destroy across modes and multiballs also feeds a running count -- reach thirty-five to start Berzerker Multiball at the left ramp.

lights.name: Cerebro & the Team
lights.lit: Five hits on the purple Nightcrawler standups (or a Cerebro skill shot) light the Cerebro lock post above the left flipper; advancing and collecting it three times at the Uptown or Highway ramp starts the team multiball.
lights.then: To Me, My X-Men pays blue jackpots that spawn all twelve X-Men, with supers at the left ramp. The same Cerebro area near the left flipper is where you build your end-of-ball Bonus X, so work it between locks.

lights.name: Save the City
lights.lit: Put three hits on all six primary shots in single-ball play to qualify the multiball; the later cycles ask for four then five hits per area, so early progress matters.
lights.then: Start it at the lit Midtown or Subway ramp, then once all five city jackpots are in take the X-Jet to arm the Danger Room spinner and rip it for a million per spin -- bounce the Kitty Pryde lane to add time to that clock.

lights.name: Danger Room Exit Ramp
lights.lit: The exit ramp is the universal jackpot multiplier and super-reset shot; it relights the jackpots at two times, then three times, and doubles a super rather than just paying it once.
lights.then: In every multiball, take the super at its home shot, then immediately combo the exit ramp to double it and reset the jackpot ladder at a higher base -- no other shot on the machine repays practice this richly.

lights.name: Gambit & Bishop Bumpers
lights.lit: Every third hit on the Gambit bumper -- or an alley pass through the right inlane -- arms the next mode or multiball shot at two times, while the Bishop bumper charges the lockbar button, and a red flash means a use is banked.
lights.then: Bank the Gambit two-times onto your biggest shot or a super rather than wasting it small, and hold up to three Bishop charges to spot the most valuable lit shot (never the Sentinel or the Danger Room) or, with the Rogue perk, add a ball.

lights.name: Standup Perks & Beast's Lab
lights.lit: The right-side X-Mansion target arms the right-outlane save at four hits and earns a perk at ten, while Beast's Lab climbs its award levels off the back of combos rather than single stray hits.
lights.then: Climb Beast's Lab past its mystery and ball-save awards until the extra ball is lit, then collect it off the right inlane; farm the Nightcrawler and Jean Grey standups on purpose for their perks and the outlane save.

scoring.text: Take the Cerebro skill shot -- it cradles the ball on the left flipper and spots a step toward the team multiball. Send two shots up the X-Jet to lock in the green training level so your first mission runs at two times, then qualify an easy mission and start it at the blue center ramp. The Downtown ramp keeps feeding the same flipper for the repeatable Time Loop, and a sixth shot after five buys fifteen seconds of ball save.

Climb the Danger Room to Level 3 so Sentinels count double and timers stretch, and arm the Gambit bumper's two-times for your biggest shots. Poke the Sentinel head to the open mouth for Sentinel Multiball, the top scorer, and drop a banked Facility Raid add-a-ball into it. Take every super at its home shot, then immediately combo the Danger Room exit ramp to double it.

Complete all eight missions to light Save Senator Kelly, a single-ball gauntlet whose final score rides on the highest combo multiplier you build before it. Sentinel Multiball is the biggest points source when it is fed by a leveled Danger Room, and defeating thirty-five Sentinels opens the Berzerker super-jackpot farm. The intended final wizard, Master Mold, is not yet finished in the current code.
